def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # 1. Позиции, купленные строго до seed_time
    items = order_items[order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (order_items['ts'] < seed_time)].copy()

    # Информация о заказе: используем только то, что известно на seed_time
    ord_cols = orders[['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_status',
                       'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_approved_at',
                       'order_delivered_carrier_date', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
                       'order_estimated_delivery_date']]
    items = items.merge(ord_cols, on='order_id', how='left')

    # Статус/даты валидны только если событие уже произошло до seed_time
    known_approved = items['order_approved_at'].notna() & (items['order_approved_at'] < seed_time)
    known_carrier = items['order_delivered_carrier_date'].notna() & (items['order_delivered_carrier_date'] < seed_time)
    known_delivered = items['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time)

    items['is_approved'] = known_approved.astype(float)
    items['is_shipped'] = known_carrier.astype(float)
    items['is_delivered'] = known_delivered.astype(float)
    items['is_canceled'] = ((items['order_status'] == 'canceled') & known_approved).astype(float)

    # Время доставки считаем только если доставка завершилась до seed_time
    items['delivery_days'] = np.where(
        known_delivered,
        (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] - items['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )
    items['delay_vs_estimated'] = np.where(
        known_delivered,
        (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] - items['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )
    items['approve_hours'] = np.where(
        known_approved,
        (items['order_approved_at'] - items['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.total_seconds() / 3600.0,
        np.nan
    )

    # 2. Отзывы: только те, что уже созданы до seed_time
    rev = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    rev_agg = rev.groupby('order_id').agg(
        mean_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        cnt_review=('review_score', 'count')
    ).reset_index()
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # 3. Платежи: только те, что известны до seed_time
    pay = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]
    pay_agg = pay.groupby('order_id').agg(
        sum_paid=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        cnt_payments=('payment_sequential', 'count'),
        mean_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean')
    ).reset_index()
    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # 4. Базовая агрегация по всей истории до seed_time
    base = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
        cnt_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        cnt_items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        mean_price=('price', 'mean'),
        std_price=('price', 'std'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        mean_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        sum_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        cnt_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        cnt_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
        mean_review_score=('mean_score', 'mean'),
        cnt_reviews=('cnt_review', 'sum'),
        sum_paid=('sum_paid', 'sum'),
        cnt_payments=('cnt_payments', 'sum'),
        mean_installments=('mean_installments', 'mean'),
        mean_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
        mean_delay=('delay_vs_estimated', 'mean'),
        mean_approve_hours=('approve_hours', 'mean'),
        frac_delivered=('is_delivered', 'mean'),
        frac_shipped=('is_shipped', 'mean'),
        frac_canceled=('is_canceled', 'mean')
    ).reset_index()

    # 5. Оконные признаки
    for N in [14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        sub = items[items['ts'] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=N)]
        g = sub.groupby('product_id')
        ord_cnt = g['order_id'].nunique()
        rev_sum = g['price'].sum()
        cust_cnt = g['customer_id'].nunique()
        base[f'orders_{N}d'] = base['product_id'].map(ord_cnt).fillna(0).values
        base[f'revenue_{N}d'] = base['product_id'].map(rev_sum).fillna(0).values
        base[f'customers_{N}d'] = base['product_id'].map(cust_cnt).fillna(0).values

    # Тренд: отношение последних 30 дней к предыдущим 30
    last30 = items[items['ts'] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    prev30 = items[(items['ts'] <= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)) &
                   (items['ts'] > seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=60))].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
    base['trend_30_30'] = base['product_id'].map(last30).fillna(0) / (base['product_id'].map(prev30).fillna(0) + 1)

    # 6. Возраст продукта и время с последней покупки
    first_ts = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].min()
    last_ts = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].max()
    base['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - base['product_id'].map(first_ts)).dt.days
    base['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - base['product_id'].map(last_ts)).dt.days

    # 7. Средний интервал между заказами (регулярность спроса)
    def _gap(s):
        u = np.sort(s.dropna().unique())
        if len(u) < 2:
            return np.nan
        return np.mean(np.diff(u)) / np.nan_to_num(86400.0) * 86400.0 / 86400.0
    gaps = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].apply(lambda s: np.mean(np.diff(np.sort(s.unique())).astype('timedelta64[s]').astype(float) / 86400.0) if s.nunique() > 1 else np.nan)
    base['mean_order_gap_days'] = base['product_id'].map(gaps)

    # 8. Финальная сборка
    base = base.set_index('product_id').reindex(entity_ids)
    base = base.fillna(0).astype(float)

    return base
